notes.title: Another update in the works
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We are actively working on giving you some features you have been requesting. We are working right now on a better camera control system and adding a few more languages. We always are listening to what you guys want and trying to meet those request.  We hope you are enjoying the game and look forward to giving you an even better experience. 

The Forthright Team
